responsibility: Declares the Resolver2_0 GlobbingVisitor used during import finalization for Rust glob imports. The class is a focused AST::DefaultASTVisitor that walks a module’s items and publishes publicly visible declarations into the NameResolutionContext as globbed entries, providing the interface TopLevel import processing uses to expose a module’s value, type, and macro exports for use::* resolution.
same_name_distinction: Declares the GlobbingVisitor interface and its visit/go entry points for glob-import finalization; unlike the .cc peer, it contains only the class definition and API surface, not the item-specific insertion behavior.
